title: I used AI to help build my Godot roguelite. Today, it finally launched on Steam!
author: morfidon
selftext:
Hey everyone!

After months of development, my game Snake: Gridbreaker is finally out in Early Access on Steam! 

The idea started with a simple question: What if classic Snake became an action roguelite?

Instead of just avoiding your growing body, you can turn it into a weapon. Your tail can burn enemies, shock them, or become something you can phase through. There are different classes, upgrades, mutations, and plenty of ways to experiment with builds.

I built the game in Godot, using AI tools as part of my development workflow.

One of the biggest things I learned was how valuable real player feedback is.

People played the demo, streamed their runs, found bugs, and suggested improvements. Watching them play helped me identify problems with controls, balance, and readability that I hadn't noticed myself.

It was incredible to see creators from different countries making videos about a game I'd been working on for months!

And now it's finally available on Steam.

If you're curious, there's also a free demo, so you can try the game without buying it.

Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4828340/Snake\_Gridbreaker/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4828340/Snake_Gridbreaker/)

Thanks for checking it out! ❤️
